description_en: Creates a data synchronization task for a disaster recovery (DR) ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于创建RDS灾备实例的数据同步链路
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-replication-link --db-instance-id rm-2zeytekus0r000000 --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateReplicationLink

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DR instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run before the system creates the DR instance. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run but does not create the instance. The system checks the request parameters, request syntax, limits, and available resources.
false (default): performs a dry run and the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, the instance is directly created
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次创建灾备实例同步链路的操作执行预检查，取值：

true：执行预检查操作，不创建实例。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the source ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance or the IP address of the source ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
parameters.help_zh: PostgreSQL源实例连接地址/SQL Server源实例IP地址
parameters.name: source_address

parameters.help_en: The port of the source instance
parameters.name: source_port

parameters.help_en: The account of the database that is used for data synchronization
parameters.help_zh: 同步数据的数据库账号
parameters.name: replicator_account

parameters.help_en: The task ID of the successful dry run
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source instance. Valid values:

other: other instances. SQL Server instances are not supported.
aliyunRDS: an ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.help_zh:
源实例的类别，取值：
other：其他。（SQL Server不支持）
aliyunRDS：阿里云RDS实例
parameters.name: source_category

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the source instance. If you set SourceCategory to aliyunRDS, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 源实例地域ID，SourceCategory取值为aliyunRDS时必须指定
parameters.name: source_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the source instance. If you set SourceCategory to aliyunRDS, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 源实例名称，SourceCategory为aliyunRDS时必须指定
parameters.name: source_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The task name of the dry run. You can specify a custom task name. If you do not specify this parameter, ApsaraDB RDS automatically generates a task name
parameters.help_zh: 预检查任务名称。自定义，未设置时系统自动生成
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the DR instance of the ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
parameters.name: target_address

DBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the DR instance
